action_items: In scripts/tac_overrides.css add a @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) rule that resets .tac-render-figure.reveal-up (and any sibling .reveal-up inside .tac-render-inner) to opacity:1 and transform:none so the ARCHITECTURE figure is visible without scroll under reduced motion. Rebuild via python3 scripts/build_tac.py.
critical_code_review_comments: ARCHITECTURE reveal mixes two systems: the new 'is-pending' driven reveal (correctly disabled under reduced motion) AND a legacy global '.reveal-up' + '.in-view' pattern on the figure. The legacy one is not gated by reduced-motion; consolidate on the is-pending system inside .tac-render-inner or ensure reduced-motion resets .reveal-up.
Two-column .tac-parking-inner grid template is fixed to '2fr 3fr'-ish px values (502/754) — verify it stays proportional between 1024 and 1440; currently OK but a fr/fr grid would be more robust.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Taç page has been thoroughly validated against iteration_42 spec. The only remaining nit is the .reveal-up figure inside .tac-render-inner still hiding under prefers-reduced-motion before scroll. Everything else (overflow, tab removal, single 4+1 plan, 15-row schedule, val alignment, lightbox, print, architecture single #0A0A0A, section order, parking/arrival exact copy, 40/60 desktop, mobile copy-above-image, WebP + srcset + figcaption + explicit w/h, reduced-motion for the new sections, east-west regression, enquiry empty-submit validation) is passing.
rca of the issue: The .tac-render-figure element carries the legacy 'reveal-up' class from the site's global scroll-in animation system. That class sets opacity:0 and transform:translateY(40px) unconditionally, and only clears when 'in-view' is added by the observer. The new is-pending path added for iteration_42 skips itself under prefers-reduced-motion (verified: archPending=false, no is-pending applied anywhere), but it does not neutralise the co-existing .reveal-up baseline. Fix by adding a reduced-motion override that unsets .reveal-up transforms/opacities inside .tac-render-inner.
